product.name: Simulated Cell™ Virtual Lab
product.description: An AI-based simulation platform for modeling cellular responses to genetic and chemical perturbations and supporting drug discovery decisions with in silico experiments.

product.name: ADC Payload Selector
product.description: A virtual screening product for selecting antibody–drug conjugate payloads or payload combinations, identifying responsive patient subgroups, and analyzing resistance mechanisms.

product.name: Target Discovery & De-risking
product.description: A computational target-identification and prioritization service that simulates perturbations, explains response and resistance mechanisms, and generates biomarker hypotheses for preclinical validation.

identifier.value: Custom and Collaborative Virtual Disease Modeling

product.name: Custom and Collaborative Virtual Disease Modeling
product.description: A tailored simulation service that uses customer datasets, therapies, and disease models to generate and interpret in silico predictions for portfolio and R&D decisions.
